# kit — v1 app template

Copy this folder to start a new app or profile in your workspace. It has
exactly three dependencies once published to the hub (app-runner):

1. `src/index.ts` must build to a single ES module whose **default export**
   is an object with `fetch(request, env)` — a plain web-standard
   `Request` in, `Response` out. No Durable Object APIs, no runtime
   bindings.
2. `env.db` — `execute(sql, params)` and `batch([{sql, params}, ...])`,
   libSQL-shaped results (`{rows, columns, rowsAffected}`). Drizzle is
   optional, over its `sqlite-proxy` driver calling `env.db.execute` from
   an in-process callback (see `data/schema.ts`).
3. The current user arrives as the `x-app-user` request header (JSON:
   `{id, name, email}`) — read it directly off `request.headers`, nothing
   is injected into `env`.

Static files sit beside the backend: `dist/index.html` + `dist/assets/*`
(built by Vite from `web/`). `data/migrations/*.sql` hold hand-written,
numbered migrations (`NNNN_description.sql`), applied by the hub on
`activate`, before `current` moves. `tools.json` lists tool routes the
colleague can call.

## Build

```
npm install
npm run build
```

Produces `dist/index.js` (esbuild bundle of `src/index.ts`, format esm,
platform neutral — no Node builtins reach the runtime) plus
`dist/index.html` and `dist/assets/*` (Vite build of `web/`, React +
TanStack Router + TanStack Query, `base: './'` and the router's basepath
read from `location.pathname` at runtime so the same build works mounted
at any `/w/{workspaceId}/{name}/` path).

Publish `dist/index.js`, `dist/index.html`, `dist/assets/*`, `tools.json`,
and `data/migrations/*.sql` to the hub (paths re-keyed under `app/` — see
`app-runner/API.md`).

## Layout

```
src/index.ts          Hono backend: page routes + /api/* + tool routes
data/schema.ts         Drizzle schema (optional) + sqlite-proxy factory
data/migrations/       0001_init.sql, 0002_..., hand-written, numbered
web/                    Vite + React + TanStack Router/Query front
tools.json              tool manifest: name, description, input schema, route
```

from pathlib import Path
import shutil
p=Path('publish')
if p.exists(): shutil.rmtree(p)
(p/'assets').mkdir(parents=True)
(p/'data'/'migrations').mkdir(parents=True)
for f in ['index.js','index.html','tools.json']:
    shutil.copy2(f,p/f)
for f in Path('assets').iterdir():
    shutil.copy2(f,p/'assets'/f.name)
for f in Path('data/migrations').glob('*.sql'):
    shutil.copy2(f,p/'data'/'migrations'/f.name)
print('\n'.join(str(x) for x in p.rglob('*') if x.is_file()))
PY
